h2: Zoning in Abbotsford, Langley, Surrey, Delta and the Fraser Valley
lead: Plain-English summaries of farm, rural, acreage and residential zones, with a link to the official bylaw for every zone. Start with the agricultural and rural zones if you are looking at a farm or acreage, or search any zone code.
checked: Checked against each official bylaw on October 2, 2026. Zoning changes often, so always confirm with the municipality.
general: These summaries may not reflect recent amendments and are not legal advice. Always confirm zoning, permitted uses and ALR status with the municipality and the Agricultural Land Commission before you buy.

lookup.d: Type an address to see its zoning, ALR status, lot size and other public map checks. It covers Surrey, Langley (City and Township) and Abbotsford for now. Anywhere else, send me the address and I'll check its zoning, ALR status and what you can build before you write an offer.
lookup.fine: General information from public municipal and provincial maps, not a survey or legal advice. The address is only used to look up public map data.

munis.name: Abbotsford
munis.source: Source: Online consolidated bylaw (laws.abbotsford.ca). All standard zones.

zones.name: Agricultural One Zone
fields: Agricultural uses and complementary activities, consistent with the Agricultural Land Commission Act.

Agriculture, one single detached dwelling, boarding house, residential care. Accessory uses include agri-tourism, farm retail sales, farm product processing, farm alcohol production, and farm worker housing.

One secondary suite (up to 100 m²). One accessory farm dwelling unit on lots of at least 0.4 ha: up to 90 m² on lots of 40 ha or less, up to 186 m² on larger lots, subject to ALR rules or ALC approval.
8.0 ha (about 19.8 acres), with limited exceptions in s.210.5.
The bylaw notes that the ALC Act and the ALR Use Regulation requirements also apply.

zones.name: Agricultural Two Zone
fields: Same agricultural and residential uses as A1.
If the lot is in the ALR, Agricultural Land Commission rules on homes, fill and subdivision also apply.

zones.name: Agricultural and Resource Processing Zone
fields: If the lot is in the ALR, Agricultural Land Commission rules on homes, fill and subdivision also apply.

zones.name: Agricultural and Produce Processing Zone
fields: If the lot is in the ALR, Agricultural Land Commission rules on homes, fill and subdivision also apply.

zones.name: Agricultural and Farm Industrial Zone
fields: A1 uses plus farm industrial use and growing medium manufacturing.
If the lot is in the ALR, Agricultural Land Commission rules on homes, fill and subdivision also apply.

zones.name: Agricultural and Commercial Mushroom Composting Zone
fields: A1 uses plus a commercial mushroom composting facility where approved by the ALC.
7.3 ha for a composting facility; otherwise same as A1.
If the lot is in the ALR, Agricultural Land Commission rules on homes, fill and subdivision also apply.

zones.name: Rural Residential Zone
fields: Single detached dwellings and agricultural uses on large lots in a rural setting.
Single detached dwelling, agriculture, resource processing, residential care, supported housing. Accessory farm retail sales.
Secondary suite; coach house only on lots over 0.4 ha.
If the lot is in the ALR, Agricultural Land Commission rules on homes, fill and subdivision also apply.

zones.name: Country Residential Zone
fields: Single detached dwellings and agricultural uses on large lots.
Secondary suite; coach house only on lots over 0.4 ha.
If the lot is in the ALR, Agricultural Land Commission rules on homes, fill and subdivision also apply.

zones.name: Suburban Residential Zone
fields: Single detached dwellings on suburban lots.
Secondary suite; coach house on lots over 0.4 ha.

zones.name: Suburban Residential Hobby Farm Zone
fields: Single detached dwellings on suburban lots with small-scale hobby farming.
A coach house on land in the ALR needs ALC approval.

zones.name: Urban Estate Residential Zone
fields: Intended for single detached dwellings on large urban lots.

zones.name: Urban Residential Zone
fields: Intended for single detached dwellings on medium urban-sized lots.

zones.name: 1 Small-Scale Multi-Unit Housing One Zone
fields: Intended to enable small-scale residential development on urban lots designated SSMUH 1 in the OCP.

zones.name: 2 Small-Scale Multi-Unit Housing Two Zone
fields: Intended to enable small-scale residential development on urban lots designated SSMUH 2 in the OCP.

zones.name: 2-g Small-Scale Multi-Unit Housing 2 – Greenfield Zone
fields: Intended to enable small-scale residential development on greenfield lots designated SSMUH 2 in the OCP.

zones.name: 3 Small-Scale Multi-Unit Housing Three Zone
fields: Intended to enable small-scale residential development on large lots designated SSMUH 3 in the OCP.

zones.name: 4 Small-Scale Multi-Unit Housing Four Zone
fields: Intended to enable small-scale residential development on suburban lots designated SSMUH 4 in the OCP.

zones.name: Urban Residential Zone, Infill
fields: Intended for single detached dwellings on urban lots in the Urban 3-Infill Land Use Designation.

zones.name: Townhouse 1 Zone
fields: Intended to enable a transition from small-scale residential development to ground-oriented multi-unit residential development on lands abutting a Local Road and designated Townhouse in the OCP.

zones.name: Townhouse 2 Zone
fields: Intended to enable a transition from small-scale residential development to ground-oriented multi-unit residential development on lands abutting an Arterial Road or a Collector Road and designated Townhouse in the OCP.

zones.name: Duplex Residential Zone
fields: Intended for single detached dwellings or duplexes (strata and fee simple) on urban lots.

zones.name: Duplex Residential Zone, Infill
fields: Intended for duplexes (strata and fee simple) on urban lots in the Urban 3-Infill Land Use Designation.

zones.name: Residential Zone
fields: Intended for single detached dwellings on standard lots without lane access.

zones.name: Residential Zone
fields: Intended for single detached dwellings on standard lots without secondary suites or lane access.

zones.name: Compact Lot Residential Zone
fields: Intended for single detached dwellings on compact lots.

zones.name: Compact Lot Coach House Residential Zone
fields: Intended for single detached dwellings and coach houses above accessory buildings on compact lots with rear lane access.

zones.name: Infill Residential Zone
fields: Intended for single detached dwellings and garden suites on compact lots in the SSMUH 1 and Townhouse Land Use Designation.

zones.name: Coach House Residential Zone
fields: Intended for single detached dwellings and coach houses on urban lots with municipal lane access in the Urban 3 – Infill Land Use Designation and new neighbourhoods.

zones.name: Infill Manufactured Home Zone
fields: Intended for single detached dwellings and fee simple manufactured homes on urban lots.

zones.name: Urban Residential Hybrid Zone
fields: Intended for conventional single detached dwellings and fee simple mobile homes on urban lots.

zones.name: Residential Corner Store Zone
fields: Intended for residential uses with accessory commercial uses in primarily residential areas in the Urban 3 – Infill or Urban 4 – Detached Land Use Designations in accordance with the policy contained within the Official Community Plan.

zones.name: Low Density Townhouse Zone
fields: Intended for townhouse developments at lower densities, up to 16 units per hectare.

zones.name: Low Density Townhouse Zone
fields: Intended for townhouse developments at lower densities, up to 30 units per hectare.

zones.name: Medium Density Townhouse Zone
fields: Intended for townhouse developments at medium densities, up to 45 units per hectare.

zones.name: High Density Townhouse Zone
fields: Intended for townhouse developments at higher densities, up to 60 units per hectare.

zones.name: Multifamily Ground Oriented Zone
fields: Intended to enable ground oriented multi-unit residential development for lands designated Townhouse in the OCP.

zones.name: Multi-Unit Residential Flex Zone
fields: Intended for townhouse developments at higher densities, up to 60 units per hectare, and to allow for secondary suites within townhouses.

zones.name: Multiplex Residential Zone
fields: Intended to establish specific land use and development regulations for three and four unit townhouse developments on existing urban lots in the Townhouse Land Use Designation.

zones.name: Rowhouse Residential Zone
fields: Intended to enable rowhouse development on consolidated lots that are designated Townhouse in the OCP.

zones.name: Low Rise Apartment Zone
fields: Intended for low-rise developments up to six storeys in height, including residential buildings and buildings for congregate care.

zones.name: Mid Rise Apartment Zone
fields: Intended for mid-rise developments up to six (6) storeys in height, including residential buildings and buildings for congregate care, for lands designated Apartment in the City’s Official Community Plan.

zones.name: Mid Rise Apartment Zone – Rental
fields: Intended for mid-rise developments up to six (6) storeys in height, including residential buildings and buildings for congregate care which are restricted to residential rental tenure only, for lands designated Apartment in the City’s Official Community Plan.

zones.name: High Rise Apartment Zone
fields: Intended for high-rise developments up to 80 metres in height, including residential buildings and buildings for congregate care.

zones.name: Mixed Use Apartment Zone
fields: Intended for low-rise, mixed-use developments up to six storeys in height, consisting of limited commercial uses on the first and second floors and apartment or congregate housing uses on upper floors.

zones.name: City Centre Residential Zone
fields: Intended for multi storey residential buildings for lands designated City Centre Core or City Centre Residential in the City Centre Neighbourhood Plan.

zones.name: Manufactured Home Park Zone
fields: Intended for manufactured homes on individual pads within an unsubdivided manufactured home park.

zones.name: Local Commercial Zone
fields: Intended for small-scale commercial uses in primarily residential areas.

zones.name: Neighbourhood Commercial Zone
fields: Intended for many commercial uses that meet the needs of the broader neighbourhood, in developments up to 10,000 m² in size.

zones.name: Community Commercial Zone
fields: Intended for many commercial uses that meet the needs of the community, in developments over 10,000 m² in size.

zones.name: Service Commercial Zone
fields: Intended for many commercial uses in buildings two storeys or less, in an automobile-oriented environment.

zones.name: Secondary Commercial Zone
fields: Intended to serve a neighbourhood or city wide area with commercial uses along with indoor industrial, for lands designated Secondary Commercial in the Official Community Plan.

zones.name: Regional Commercial Zone
fields: Intended to provide for large format retail centres with large anchor tenants and surface parking on lands designated Regional Commercial in the Official Community Plan.

zones.name: City Centre Commercial Zone
fields: Intended for many uses appropriate for the City Centre including retail, office, financial, service and residential uses in conjunction with commercial uses, in low-rise buildings up to six storeys.

zones.name: City Centre Mixed Use Zone
fields: Intended for multi storey buildings and many uses, for lands designated City Centre Core in the City Centre Neighbourhood Plan.

zones.name: Commercial High Rise Zone
fields: Intended for commercial and mixed-use developments up to 80 metres in height along and within close proximity to the City’s Primary Transit Corridor.

zones.name: Historic Downtown Commercial Zone
fields: Intended for commercial and mixed-use developments in the Historic Downtown area.

zones.name: Gas Station Commercial Zone
fields: Intended to provide a zone to meet the specific safety and health standards required to accommodate gas stations, automobile maintenance and repair facilities and other associated uses.

zones.name: Automall Commercial Zone
fields: Intended for automobile, commercial vehicle, and recreational vehicle dealerships and other associated uses within an automall format.

zones.name: Recreation and Campground Zone
fields: Intended for outdoor sport uses, campgrounds and resort accommodation uses on large lots.

zones.name: Golf Course Zone
fields: Intended for golf courses and uses associated with golf courses, including accessory buildings, club houses, driving ranges and other associated uses.

zones.name: Urban Centre Zone
fields: Intended to enable a mix of multi-unit residential and commercial uses that serve a city-wide and neighbourhood function, on lands designated Urban Centre in the OCP.

zones.name: Neighbourhood Centre Zone
fields: Intended to enable a mix of multi unit residential and commercial uses that function as neighbourhood gathering places and destinations including shops, restaurants, cafes, and services, on land designated Neighbourhood Centre in the OCP.

zones.name: Residential Industrial Zone
fields: Intended for single detached dwellings on industrial lots, with home based businesses and small-scale industrial uses.

zones.name: Light Industrial Zone
fields: Intended for commercial vehicle parking with a limited number of light industrial uses and outdoor storage.

zones.name: General Industrial Zone
fields: Intended for a mix of light industrial uses.

zones.name: High Impact Industrial Zone
fields: Intended for high impact industrial uses, as well as a limited number of light industrial uses that are compatible with high impact uses.

zones.name: Airport Zone
fields: Intended for airport facilities and limited commercial uses that are complementary to the Abbotsford International Airport.

zones.name: Special Industrial Zone
fields: Intended for a variety of site-specific industrial uses.

zones.name: Civic Institutional Zone
fields: Intended for general civic and institutional uses.

zones.name: Park, Open Space and School Zone
fields: Intended for public uses such as parks, child care centres and schools.

zones.name: Assembly Zone
fields: Intended for assembly and school uses.

zones.name: Special Housing Zone
fields: Intended for congregate housing, congregate care uses and other community support services.

zones.name: River Zone
fields: Intended to provide for the use of a river for water-related recreation, storage, transportation and other related uses.

zones.name: Entertainment and Sports Centre Zone
fields: Intended for entertainment and sports uses.

zones.name: University/College Campus Zone
fields: Intended for educational, recreational, residential and commercial uses associated with universities, colleges and other post-secondary educational institutions.

zones.name: Health Campus Zone
fields: Intended for uses on lands designated Health Campus in the City’s Official Community Plan.

zones.name: N2 … Comprehensive Development Zones
fields: Site-specific zones numbered N1, N2 and up (Section 800). Each has its own permitted uses and rules, so read the zone that applies to the property.

munis.name: Township of Langley
munis.bylaw: Township of Langley Zoning Bylaw No. 2500
munis.source: Source: Section PDFs on tol.ca (Section 100 updated July 28, 2026). Rural, suburban and residential zones in detail; commercial, industrial and institutional zones grouped. City of Langley has its own, separate zoning bylaw.

zones.name: Rural Zone
fields: Agriculture, equestrian centres and riding stables, commercial greenhouses, mushroom farms, veterinary clinics, residential use. Feedlots and intensive swine operations only as the bylaw allows.
Subject to the ALC Act, no more than 2 single family dwellings or mobile homes per lot, with exceptions set out in the bylaw.
If the lot is in the ALR, Agricultural Land Commission rules on homes, fill and subdivision also apply.

zones.name: Rural Zone
fields: RU-1 uses plus kennels, dog daycare, fur farms and animal pounds.
If the lot is in the ALR, Agricultural Land Commission rules on homes, fill and subdivision also apply.

zones.name: Rural Zone
fields: If the lot is in the ALR, Agricultural Land Commission rules on homes, fill and subdivision also apply.

zones.name: Rural Floodplain Zone
fields: RU-1 uses plus a class B marina.
Homes must be built at the Flood Construction Level on natural ground, without fill.
If the lot is in the ALR, Agricultural Land Commission rules on homes, fill and subdivision also apply.

zones.name: Rural Floodplain Zone
fields: The Flood Construction Level may be reached by structural elevation or up to 0.91 m of fill.
If the lot is in the ALR, Agricultural Land Commission rules on homes, fill and subdivision also apply.

zones.name: Rural Floodplain Zone
fields: If the lot is in the ALR, Agricultural Land Commission rules on homes, fill and subdivision also apply.

zones.name: Rural Processing Zone
fields: RU-1 uses plus meat processing plants or abattoirs (no retail sales) in a fully enclosed building.
If the lot is in the ALR, Agricultural Land Commission rules on homes, fill and subdivision also apply.
zones.note: Named “Rural Processing Zone” in s.104.1; the Section 200 heading reads “Agricultural Processing Zone”.

zones.name: Rural Zone
fields: If the lot is in the ALR, Agricultural Land Commission rules on homes, fill and subdivision also apply.

zones.name: Rural Estate Winery Zone
fields: Agriculture, a licensed winery and one dwelling.
If the lot is in the ALR, Agricultural Land Commission rules on homes, fill and subdivision also apply.
zones.note: Named “Rural Estate Winery Zone” in s.104.1; the Section 200 heading reads “Rural Winery Zone”.

zones.name: Rural Farm Market Zone
fields: A farm market on a farm in the ALR.
Farm market site up to 0.4 ha and no more than 5% of the farm unit; area for products from off the farm up to 130 m²; farm unit at least 8.0 ha.
No subdivision is permitted to facilitate an RU-14 development.
If the lot is in the ALR, Agricultural Land Commission rules on homes, fill and subdivision also apply.

zones.name: Suburban Residential Zone
fields: One small-scale multi-unit housing development, or one single family dwelling plus one accessory dwelling unit (if there is no secondary suite), subject to the ALC Act where it applies.

zones.name: Suburban Residential Zone
fields: One single family dwelling or mobile home, plus an accessory dwelling unit if outside the urban containment boundary and there is no secondary suite.

zones.name: Suburban Residential Zone
fields: Small-scale multi-unit housing, or one single family dwelling plus an accessory dwelling unit.
Only on land in the ALR.

zones.name: Suburban Residential Zone
fields: One single family dwelling plus an accessory dwelling unit.

zones.name: Suburban Residential Zone
fields: One single family dwelling plus an accessory dwelling unit.
2,023 m² (about 0.5 acres). Added by Bylaw No. 6144 (July 27, 2026).

zones.name: Comprehensive Rural Estates Zone
fields: 0.2 ha, with an average of 0.33 ha and an overall density of no more than 1.61 units per hectare.

zones.name: Residential Zone
fields: 464.5 m², with an average lot size of 557.4 m².

zones.name: Residential Compact Lot Zone
fields: 220 m² (about 2,368 sq ft), front or rear-loaded; see s.403.7.

zones.name: Residential Compact Lot Zone
fields: 275 m² front-loaded, 266 m² rear-loaded (excluding corner lots); see s.404.9.

zones.name: Residential Compact Lot Zone
fields: 315 m² front-loaded, 266 m² rear-loaded (excluding corner lots); see s.405.9.

zones.name: Residential Compact Lot Zone
fields: 390 m² (about 4,198 sq ft) for rear-loaded lots; 465 m² for corner lots.

zones.name: Residential Compact Lot Zone
fields: 168 m² for an internal rowhouse lot, 201 m² for an end lot and 254 m² for a corner lot.

zones.name: Residential Compact Lot Zone
fields: 592 m² (about 6,372 sq ft); 656 m² for corner lots.

zones.name: Residential Compact Lot Zone
fields: 201 m² for an interior lot and 254 m² for a corner lot, with a maximum of 280 m².

zones.name: Residential Float Home Zone
fields: Up to 40 float homes moored at a Class "C" marina, plus one single family dwelling or mobile home on the upland lot for the owner, manager or caretaker.

zones.name: to RM-4 Multiple Family Residential Zones
fields: Zones RM-1, RM-2, RM-3, RM-3A and RM-4. Minimum new lot: 3,716 m² in RM-1; 1,672 m² in RM-2 and RM-3.

zones.name: Fraser River Zone
fields: Uses on and along the Fraser River.

zones.name: Rural Game Farm Zone
fields: Game farm or zoological park, with up to 4 dwellings.

zones.name: to C-18 Commercial Zones
fields: Includes C-1 Regional Commercial, C-2 to C-2D Community Commercial, C-3 and C-3A Service Commercial, C-4 and C-5 Neighbourhood Commercial, C-6 Service Station, C-7, C-8 and C-13 to C-16 Limited Commercial, C-9 Campground Commercial, C-10 Customs Commercial, C-11 Farm Auction, C-12 Liquor Primary, C-17 Carvolth Commercial and C-18 Carvolth Business Park.

zones.name: to M-14 Industrial Zones
fields: Includes M-1A and M-1B Service Industrial, M-2 to M-2B General Industrial, M-3, M-4 and M-13 Heavy Industrial, M-5, M-5A, M-6 and M-10 Limited Industrial, M-7 Salvage Industrial, M-8 Industrial Transition, M-11 Business/Office Park, M-12 Rural Service Industrial and M-14 Brookswood Employment (added July 27, 2026).

zones.name: to P-6 Institutional Zones
fields: Includes P-1 and P-1A Civic Institutional, P-2A to P-2R Community Care Facility, P-3 and P-3A Residential Institutional, P-4 Airport, P-5 and P-5A Limited Institutional, and P-6 Post Office.

zones.name: Comprehensive Development Zones
fields: Site-specific zones (CD-1, CD-2 and up), each with its own rules. Check the zone that applies to the property.

munis.name: Surrey
munis.source: Source: Consolidated PDF on surrey.ca (updated Sept 23, 2026). Residential zones R1 to R7 replaced the RF, RH and RQ zones on July 8, 2024. Former codes are shown on each card.

zones.name: General Agriculture Zone
fields: Agriculture on lots of at least 2 ha, protecting land designated Agricultural in the OCP.

Agriculture and horticulture; one single family dwelling (which may contain one secondary suite); intensive agriculture (inside the ALR only); farm alcohol production; forestry; horse riding and boarding. Agri-tourism and kennels are limited to 10% building coverage.
4 ha (about 9.9 acres) inside the ALR; 2 ha (about 4.9 acres) outside it.
If the lot is in the ALR, Agricultural Land Commission rules on homes, fill and subdivision also apply.

zones.name: Intensive Agriculture Zone
fields: General and intensive agriculture, inside or outside the ALR.
Aquaculture; soil processing (outside the ALR unless authorized).
If the lot is in the ALR, Agricultural Land Commission rules on homes, fill and subdivision also apply.

zones.name: Acreage Residential Zone
fields: Acreage lots typically 4,050 m² (about 1 acre) or larger, with up to 2 dwelling units. Existing lots under 4,050 m² may have small-scale multi-unit housing of 2 to 6 units.

zones.name: Suburban Residential Zone
fields: Small-scale multi-unit housing (2 to 6 units) on suburban lots typically larger than 1,858 m² (about 0.46 acres).
Only on lots of 2 ha or more, excluding poultry, mushroom, piggery and mink operations.

zones.name: Quarter Acre Residential Zone
fields: Intended for small-scale multi-unit housing on large lots typically 930 m² or larger, which may accommodate 2 to 6 dwelling units, where lot size may be reduced with substantial public open space set aside within the subdivision.
930 m² (about 10,010 sq ft), with reductions where public open space is set aside.

zones.name: Oceanfront Residential Zone
fields: Intended for small-scale multi-unit housing on oceanfront lots typically 1,000 m² or larger, which may accommodate 2 to 6 dwelling units, where there are no lots located between the subject lot and the oceanfront, except for railway land.

zones.name: Urban Residential Zone
fields: Intended for small-scale multi-unit housing on urban sized lots typically 560 m² or larger, which may accommodate 2 to 6 dwelling units.

zones.name: Small Lot Residential Zone
fields: Intended for small-scale multi-unit housing on small lots typically 336 m² or larger, which may accommodate 2 to 6 dwelling units.

zones.name: Compact Residential Zone
fields: Intended for small-scale multi-unit housing on compact and typically rear lane accessed lots 291 m² or larger, which may accommodate 2 to 6 dwelling units.

zones.name: Semi-Detached Residential Zone
fields: Intended for small-scale multi-unit housing on small narrow lots typically less than 280 m², containing a zero-lot line Semi-Detached Residential Building, which may accommodate 2 to 3 dwelling units, or on lots larger than 280 m², containing a zero-lot line Duplex, which may accommodate 4 to 6 dwelling units.

zones.name: Cluster Residential Zone
fields: Intended for a range of residential development, from small‑scale multi-unit housing, to townhouses, to low‑rise apartments, that are clustered on portions of a site, and where open space is provided to protect natural features, that are developed in accordance with a comprehensive design.

zones.name: Manufactured Home Residential Zone
fields: Intended for the provision of manufactured home parks.

zones.name: Low Density Townhouse Zone
fields: Intended for low density townhouses, that are developed in accordance with a comprehensive design.

zones.name: Medium Density Townhouse Zone
fields: Intended for medium density townhouses, that are developed in accordance with a comprehensive design.

zones.name: Row House Zone
fields: Intended for attached dwelling units on lots contained in a row housing building.

zones.name: High Density Townhouse Zone
fields: Intended for high density townhouses, that are developed in accordance with a comprehensive design.

zones.name: Stacked Townhouse Zone
fields: Intended for stacked townhouses, typically 3 to 4 storeys, that are developed in accordance with a comprehensive design.

zones.name: Low-Rise (4 Storey) Apartment Zone
fields: Intended for low-rise apartment buildings, typically 3 to 4 storeys, with optional accessory uses such as commercial, that are developed in accordance with a comprehensive design.

zones.name: Low-Rise (4 Storey) Apartment with Commercial Zone
fields: Intended for low-rise mixed-use apartment buildings, typically 3 to 4 storeys, with required ground floor commercial, that are developed in accordance with a comprehensive design.

zones.name: Multiple Residential 70 Zone
fields: Intended for medium density, high- rise multiple unit residential buildings and related private amenity spaces, which are to be developed in accordance with a comprehensive design.

zones.name: Low-Rise (5-8 Storey) Apartment Zone
fields: Intended for low-rise apartment buildings, typically 5 to 8 storeys, with optional accessory uses such as commercial, that are developed in accordance with a comprehensive design.

zones.name: Low-Rise (5-8 Storey) Apartment with Commercial Zone
fields: Intended for low-rise mixed-use apartment buildings, typically 5 to 8 storeys, with required ground floor commercial, that are developed in accordance with a comprehensive design.

zones.name: Mid-Rise Apartment Zone
fields: Intended for mid-rise apartment buildings, typically 10 to 20 storeys, with optional accessory uses such as commercial, that are developed in accordance with a comprehensive design.

zones.name: Mid-Rise Apartment with Commercial Zone
fields: Intended for mid-rise mixed-use apartment buildings, typically up to 25 storeys, with required ground floor commercial, that are developed in accordance with a comprehensive design.

zones.name: High-Rise Apartment Zone
fields: Intended for high-rise apartment buildings, typically up to 40 storeys, with optional accessory uses such as commercial, that are developed in accordance with a comprehensive design.

zones.name: High-Rise Apartment with Commercial Zone
fields: Intended for high-rise mixed-use apartment buildings, typically up to 40 storeys, with required ground floor commercial, that are developed in accordance with a comprehensive design.

zones.name: City Centre High-Rise Apartment Zone
fields: Intended for high-density high-rise apartment buildings in City Centre, typically in tower form, with optional accessory uses such as commercial, that are developed in accordance with a comprehensive design.

zones.name: City Centre High-Rise Apartment with Commercial Zone
fields: Intended for high-density high-rise mixed-use apartment buildings in City Centre, typically in tower form, with required ground floor commercial, that are developed in accordance with a comprehensive design.

zones.name: Special Care Housing 1 Zone
fields: Intended for outside Town Centres (see Schedule D), the development of care facilities, which may be subject to the Community Care and Assisted Living Act, as amended.

zones.name: Special Care Housing 1A Zone
fields: Intended for alcohol and drug recovery houses and single family dwellings.

zones.name: Special Care Housing 2 Zone
fields: Intended for the development within Town Centres (see Schedule D), of care facilities, which may be subject to the Community Care and Assisted Living Act, as amended.

zones.name: Special Compact Residential Zone
fields: Intended for small-scale multi-unit housing on compact and typically rear lane accessed lots 291 m² or larger, which may accommodate 2 to 6 dwelling units, with optional limited commercial accessory uses.

zones.name: Cemetery Zone
fields: Intended to accommodate cemeteries and related uses, subject to the Cemetery and Funeral Services Act, as amended.

zones.name: Assembly Hall 1 Zone
fields: Intended for neighbourhood-scale assembly halls, including places of worship, private schools and child care centres.

zones.name: Assembly Hall 2 Zone
fields: Intended for regional-scale assembly halls, including places of worship, private schools and child care centres.

zones.name: Institutional Zone
fields: Intended to accommodate public and private hospitals and public and private universities and colleges.

zones.name: Local Commercial Zone
fields: Intended for local small scale commercial developments.

zones.name: Neighbourhood Commercial Zone
fields: Intended for neighbourhood scale shopping nodes.

zones.name: Community Commercial Zone
fields: Intended for community shopping centres serving a community of several neighbourhoods.

zones.name: Town Centre Commercial Zone
fields: Intended for retail and service commercial facilities, offices, recreation and associated uses as well as residential uses developed in a comprehensive manner, serving a town of several communities.

zones.name: Downtown Commercial Zone
fields: Intended for comprehensive commercial projects of retail, office, service, recreational and residential uses in City Centre.

zones.name: Highway Commercial Industrial Zone
fields: Intended for those commercial and related uses requiring large lots and exposure to major highways, which generally are not accommodated in shopping centre, Town Centre or City Centre (Schedule D) developments.

zones.name: Self-Service Gasoline Station Zone
fields: Intended for self-service gasoline stations and accessory uses.

zones.name: Combined Service Gasoline Station Zone
fields: Intended for full-service gasoline stations or combined full-service and self-service gasoline stations and accessory uses including convenience store and automotive repair.

zones.name: Tourist Accommodation Zone
fields: Intended for tourist accommodation, tourist trailer parks and camp-sites and shall apply in conjunction with the Surrey Mobile Home and Trailer Regulations and Control By-law, as amended.

zones.name: Child Care Zone
fields: Intended for large child care centres within a single family dwelling.

zones.name: Golf Course Zone
fields: Intended for golf courses as recreational commercial developments.

zones.name: Marina Zone
fields: Intended for marinas and associated uses as recreational commercial developments.

zones.name: Business Park Zone
fields: Intended for the comprehensive design of industrial business parks.

zones.name: Business Park 1 Zone
fields: Intended to permit development of industrial business parks with a high standard of design forming part of a comprehensive design.

zones.name: Business Park 2 Zone
fields: Intended for industrial business park uses that are generally compatible with one another and with adjoining zones and with a high standard of design.

zones.name: Business Park 3 Zone
fields: Intended for the comprehensive design of industrial business parks.

zones.name: Light Impact Industrial Zone

paras: The Agricultural Land Reserve (ALR) is provincial. On ALR land, Agricultural Land Commission (ALC) rules apply in addition to municipal zoning, and local governments can add further restrictions.
Generally one residence is allowed per parcel. The principal residence can be up to 500 m² in total floor area, with no more than 1,000 m² of fill placed for its construction.
A secondary suite is allowed only inside the principal residence, and only if local bylaws allow it.

One additional detached residence may be allowed without an ALC application if only one residence exists when construction starts: up to 90 m² on parcels of 40 ha or less, or up to 186 m² on parcels over 40 ha. It does not need to be for farm help. Local zoning may still limit it.
Most subdivision of ALR land needs ALC approval, including parcels under 2 acres.
alr.source: Source: Agricultural Land Commission, checked October 2, 2026.

d.t: Don't assume a property can be subdivided. Check the minimum lot size, and on ALR land, ALC approval.
Zoning and ALC rules both limit homes, suites and coach houses.
Ask for septic records and have the system inspected. Septic rules come from the health authority.
Find out whether it's a well or municipal water. For a well, ask about yield, water quality and any water licence.
Ask BC Assessment whether the property has farm class. If you plan to keep livestock or poultry, ask about BC's Premises ID program.

disclaimer: This directory is a general summary prepared from each municipality's published zoning bylaw and the Agricultural Land Commission's website, checked October 2, 2026. Bylaws are amended often, site-specific zones and covenants may apply, and summaries leave out many regulations (setbacks, density, parking, floodplain and development permit requirements, among others). It is not legal, planning or survey advice. Always confirm zoning, permitted uses, lot size and ALR status directly with the municipality and the ALC before you buy, sell or build. City of Langley and Pitt Meadows are not covered here.
